sentences.text: Shri B.J. Chourasiya - Advocate for the appellants.
Shri Aditya Gupta - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.
Shri Shivam Gautam - Advocate for the Objector.

Order 
This is first application filed by the applicants under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail in relation to FIR/Crime No.156/2024 for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 368, 376(2)(N), 376(3), 376(2)(Cha), 212, 195-A of IPC and Section 3/ 4 and 5/ 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
Applicants apprehending their arrest in the aforesaid offence has knocked at the portal of this Court for grant of anticipatory bail.
2. As per prosecution story on 13.06.2024, 15 years and 4 months old prosecutrix left her house at the pretext of going to market thereafter she did not return to home.
Her father informed to Police about her missing.
A missing report and FIR for commission of offence under Section 363 of IPC was registered.
On 22.06.2024 she was recovered.
According to her she was taken away by Rakesh and he repeatedly committed rape/ aggravated NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:46204 2 MCRC-38249-2024 penetrative sexual assault upon her.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that the applicants have not committed any offence.
They are innocent.
They have been falsely implicated.
It is contended that in statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C prosecutix has not stated anything against the present applicants.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicants may be released on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: 4. On the other hand learned counsel for the State has opposed for grant of bail, but counsel for the victim has submitted that he has no objection, if applicants are released on anticipatory bail.
5. DNA report has already been received and same is positive with regard to main accused.

6. Having taken into consideration the gravity of allegations, but without expressing anything on merits of the case I am of the view that it is not a fit case for grant of anticipatory bail as investigation is still undergoing.
Therefore, this bail application for grant of anticipatory bail is dismissed.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Vin**
